_what: Verbatim SI section-3.2 records, one per numbered synthesis heading. Nothing here is reconciled; the contradictions are preserved on purpose.

records.block: Heptadecan-9-yl 8-((2-hydroxyethyl)amino)octanoate (0.26 g, 0.60 mmol), 4-(4- fluorobutoxy)-4-oxobutyl 6-bromohexanoate (0.25 g, 0.72 mmol), K2CO3 (623 mg, 4.5 mmol), and KI (30 mg, 0.2 mmol) were added to a flask containing 15 mL of CH CN. 3 S24 The mixture solution was refluxed at 85 °C for 4 h and monitored by TLC. Upon completion, the solution was dried under decompression conditions, and the obtained residues were redissolved in 20 mL of DCM and washed with brine (3 x 40 mL). The combined organic layer was concentrated to give crude product, which was further purified by silica column chromatography (eluent: MeOH/DCM = 1:20, 12 g pre-packed column) to afford product as a light yellow oil (0.21 g, 3.6 mmol, 45.6% yield).
